name: VolMirror: underdog when implied vol is low
description: The mirror of VolFavorite: late in a 15-minute window (4, 3 or 2 minutes left), when the market's implied vol is in the lowest 5% of the coin's history relative to a HAR forecast from recent realized vol, buy the cheap (under 30c) underdog. The market is pricing too calm a regime, so long shots are underpriced.
hypothesis: Dev-data screen (research/s1.py, walk-forward HAR): underdog edge falls monotonically as the implied/forecast ratio rises, the mirror of volfav. Level is positive only in the bottom 5% at h=120-240s with underdog under 30c: +1.64c/market (se 0.54, 5245 markets, 6/8 months, 4/5 coins; SOL negative). Other horizons (300-480, 600-840) ~0, so the horizon window is a weaker, partly post-hoc choice. Wrong if the walk-forward isn't promising or the edge vanishes against book depth on thin underdog books. Same family as volfav-pool (shares its lockbox history).
